<script>
(function () {
  function getCookie(name) {
    const prefix = name + "=";
    const cookie = document.cookie
      .split("; ")
      .find(item => item.startsWith(prefix));

    return cookie ? cookie.substring(prefix.length) : null;
  }

  // Prevent this cleanup from affecting future valid gated submissions.
  if (getCookie("VisitorStatusCleanup2026") === "complete") {
    return;
  }

  // Correct previously issued long-lived Identified cookies.
  if (getCookie("VisitorStatus") === "Identified") {
    document.cookie =
      "VisitorStatus=Anonymous; Path=/; Max-Age=31536000; Secure; SameSite=Lax";
  }

  // Remember that this browser has received the cleanup.
  document.cookie =
    "VisitorStatusCleanup2026=complete; Path=/; Max-Age=31536000; Secure; SameSite=Lax";
})();
</script>    <style>

    <style>
        /* ================================
   SIGN IN DROPDOWN (CSS–ONLY)
   ================================ */

/* 1) Make sure the utility links are not translucent as a group */
.header__utility-links {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Slightly fade link text by color instead of container opacity */
.header__utility-links .header__signin-link,
.header__utility-links .header__trust-link,
.header__utility-links .header__signin-dd > .header__signin-link {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

/* Make the Sign In button look like the other header links */
.header__signin-trigger {
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 12px;
}

/* 2) Sign In dropdown wrapper sits inline with other utility links */
.header__utility-links .header__signin-dd {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

/* 3) Dropdown menu overlays, not pushing content */
.header__signin-menu {
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;          /* directly under the trigger */
  right: 0;
  min-width: 220px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 8px;
  list-style: none;

  background: #fff; 
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08);
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08);

  display: none;      /* hidden by default */
  z-index: 1200;      /* above header panels/search */
}

/* 4) Open menu on hover OR when keyboard focus is inside */
.header__signin-dd:hover > .header__signin-menu,
.header__signin-dd:focus-within > .header__signin-menu {
  display: block;
}

/* 5) Menu item styling */
.header__signin-menu a {
  display: block;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  color: var(--midnight-medium, #111);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.header__signin-menu a:hover,
.header__signin-menu a:focus {
  background: #f3f4f6;
}

/* Visible focus inside the dropdown (dark ring on light bg) */
.header__signin-menu a:focus,
.header__signin-menu a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #0d1025;
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

/* 6) Make sure the header strip can show the dropdown without clipping */
.header__utility-links-wrapper {
  overflow: visible;
}

/* 7) Optional subtle animation (no layout shift) */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .header__signin-menu {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    transition: opacity .14s ease, transform .14s ease;
  }

  .header__signin-dd:hover > .header__signin-menu,
  .header__signin-dd:focus-within > .header__signin-menu {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

/* Mobile note: .header__utility-links is display:none under the main header
   breakpoint in your SCSS, so this dropdown is effectively desktop-only
   unless you expose it in the mobile panel. */

/* Mobile Styling */

@media (max-width: 1183px) {
  .header__utility-links .header__signin-link,
  .header__utility-links .header__trust-link,
  .header__utility-links .header__signin-dd > .header__signin-link {
    color: var(--midnight-main);   /* this matches how the live site does it */
  }
}

/* MOBILE: make the Sign In dropdown full-width and inline in the menu */
@media (max-width: 1183px) {
  /* Let the wrapper behave like a normal block in the vertical menu */
  .header__utility-links .header__signin-dd {
    display: block;
    position: static;
    margin-bottom: 16px;    /* matches other items' spacing */
  }
  
  /* MOBILE: make the Sign In text match mobile styling */
  .header__signin-trigger {
    font-size:14px;
  }

  /* Dropdown menu becomes a normal block list, full width */
  .header__signin-menu {
    position: static;
    margin-top: 2px;
    padding: 0px 0 4px 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;

    background: transparent;        /* inherit mobile panel bg */
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  .header__signin-menu li {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .header__signin-menu a {
    padding: 8px 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    color: var(--midnight-main);
    font-size: 14px;
    display: block;
  }

  .header__signin-menu a:hover,
  .header__signin-menu a:focus {
    background: transparent;        /* or a subtle gray if you want */
  }
}
        </style>

    <style>
        /************ IDIO CONTENT RECOMMENDATIONS ************/

section .idio-recommendations {
  padding-top: 4rem;
  padding-bottom: 4rem; 
}

.idio-recommendations {
  display: none;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 30px;
  max-width: 1280px;
  margin: auto;
  padding-left: 16px;
  padding-right: 16px;
}


/* Responsive settings for content recommendations grid */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .idio-recommendations {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .idio-recommendations {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  }
}

.idio-recommendation {
  display: grid; /* Use CSS Grid */
  background: white;
  grid-template-areas:
    "image"
    "label"
    "title"
    "content"
    "meta"
    "source"; 
  grid-template-rows: auto auto auto 1fr auto auto;
  align-items: stretch; /* Stretch items to fill the row height */
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.idio-recommendation img {
  grid-area: image;
  max-width: 30%;
  padding-left: 18px;
  padding-top: 18px;
}

.idio-recommendation h3 {
  grid-area: title;
  color: var(--dk-midnight);
  font-size: x-large;
  line-height: 1.1;
  padding: 18px;
}

.idio-recommendation p {
  grid-area: content;
  padding: 18px 18px 24px 18px;
}

.idio-recommendation a:hover {
  color: var(--midnight);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.idio-recommendation p a {
  color: var(--midnight);
  font-weight: bold;
}


.idio-recommendation p a:hover {
  color: var(--midnight);
  text-decoration: underline;
}


.idio-recommendation .meta {
  grid-area: meta;
  background: purple;
  display: none;
}
.idio-recommendation .topics {
  background: green;
  display: none;
}

.idio-recommendation .source {
  background: red;
}


        </style>

    <style>
        /*
 * Blog detail brand refresh
 *
 * Load after connectwise_bundle2.css and constants.css.
 * All selectors are scoped to .blog-detail so this layer does not affect
 * listing pages or shared cards.
 */

.blog-detail {
    --blog-surface: var(--bg-neutral-50, #f5f8f5);
    --blog-text: var(--txt-neutral-900, #25282a);
    --blog-muted: var(--txt-neutral-700, #5e5f5e);
    --blog-line: var(--bg-neutral-200, #e0dfd7);
    --blog-radius-lg: 32px;
    --blog-radius-md: 24px;
    --blog-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.12);

    background: var(--blog-surface);
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

/* Hero ------------------------------------------------------------------- */

.blog-detail .hero--article {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    /* Sticky TOC/promo descendants must not be clipped by the hero. */
    overflow: visible;
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero--article .hero__background {
    /* Overrides the per-block --background-color set by the CMS. */
    --background-color:
        radial-gradient(
            60% 95% at 0% 100%,
            rgba(255, 105, 0, 0.2) 0%,
            rgba(255, 184, 28, 0.1) 42%,
            rgba(255, 184, 28, 0) 72%
        ),
        radial-gradient(
            44% 75% at 78% 0%,
            rgba(255, 184, 28, 0.24) 0%,
            rgba(255, 234, 194, 0.08) 52%,
            rgba(255, 234, 194, 0) 78%
        ),
        var(
            --bg-gradient-soft-glow,
            linear-gradient(135deg, #fff5e1 0%, #f5f8f5 48%, #eec6ff 100%)
        );
    /* The first layer is the warm handoff rule. Anchoring it here keeps the
       rule at the bottom of the background when the image overflows it. */
    background:
        var(
            --bg-gradient-signal,
            linear-gradient(90deg, #ff6900 0%, #ffb81c 62%, #ffd489 100%)
        ) bottom / 100% 6px no-repeat,
        var(--background-color);
}

.blog-detail .hero--article,
.blog-detail .hero--article h1,
.blog-detail .hero--article h2,
.blog-detail .hero--article h3,
.blog-detail .hero--article h4,
.blog-detail .hero--article h5,
.blog-detail .hero--article p,
.blog-detail .hero--article .eyebrow,
.blog-detail .hero--article .eyebrow p {
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero--article .heading-1 {
    width: auto;
    max-width: none;
    text-wrap: balance;
}

.blog-detail .hero--article .eyebrow,
.blog-detail .hero--article .eyebrow p {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00);
}

.blog-detail .hero--article a:not(.button) {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00);
    text-decoration-color: color-mix(
        in srgb,
        var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00) 45%,
        transparent
    );
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
}

.blog-detail .hero--article a:not(.button):hover {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-800, #8a1908);
    text-decoration-color: currentColor;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics .eyebrow,
.blog-detail .hero__topics .eyebrow p,
.blog-detail .hero__topics ul {
    margin: 0;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics .eyebrow,
.blog-detail .hero__topics .eyebrow p {
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics ul {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics li {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 0;
}

/* Normalize the legacy separator, then rebuild it with matching space on
   each side so it remains centered between any number of topic pills. */
.blog-detail .hero__topics li::before,
.blog-detail .hero__topics li::after {
    content: none;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics li + li::before {
    content: "|";
    position: static;
    display: inline-block;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--blog-muted);
    font: inherit;
    line-height: 1;
    transform: none;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics a:not(.button) {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--brand-signal-200, #ffd489);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255, 245, 225, 0.72);
    color: var(--blog-text);
    text-decoration: none;
}

.blog-detail .hero__topics a:not(.button):hover {
    background: var(--brand-signal-100, #ffeac2);
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero__image {
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--blog-radius-lg);
    box-shadow: var(--blog-shadow);
}

.blog-detail .hero__image img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
}

.blog-detail .hero__progress {
    background: var(
        --bg-gradient-focus,
        linear-gradient(90deg, #8a1908 0%, #dc4405 75%, #ff6900 100%)
    );
}

/* Contents --------------------------------------------------------------- */

.blog-detail .hero__toc {
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero__toc-list {
    border-left-color: var(--blog-line);
}

.blog-detail .hero__toc-list a:not(.button) {
    color: var(--blog-muted);
}

.blog-detail .hero__toc-list a:not(.button):hover,
.blog-detail .hero__toc-list a:not(.button):focus-visible {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00);
}

/* Hero promo -------------------------------------------------------------- */

.blog-detail .hero__promo {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
    border: 1px solid var(--brand-signal-200, #ffd489);
    border-radius: var(--blog-radius-md);
    background: var(
        --bg-gradient-signal-light,
        linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd489 0%, #ffeac2 55%, #fff5e1 100%)
    );
    box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(94, 11, 7, 0.1);
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -72px;
    bottom: -92px;
    width: 220px;
    height: 220px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(
        circle,
        rgba(255, 105, 0, 0.2),
        rgba(255, 105, 0, 0) 70%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo h3 {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    color: var(--blog-text);
    text-wrap: balance;
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo-copy,
.blog-detail .hero__promo-copy p {
    color: var(--blog-muted);
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-fill) border-box;
    color: var(--button-primary-dark-text);
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button::before {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-stroke) border-box;
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:hover,
.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:focus-visible {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-fill-hover) border-box;
    color: var(--button-primary-dark-text-hover);
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:hover::before,
.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:focus-visible::before {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-stroke-hover) border-box;
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:active {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-fill-active) border-box;
    color: var(--button-primary-dark-text-active);
}

.blog-detail .hero__promo .button:active::before {
    background: var(--button-primary-dark-stroke-active) border-box;
}

/* Key takeaways ----------------------------------------------------------- */

.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 0 clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px);
    padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
    border: 1px solid var(--blog-line);
    border-radius: var(--blog-radius-lg);
    background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(245, 248, 245, 0.86), rgba(245, 248, 245, 0.86)),
        var(
            --bg-gradient-soft-glow,
            linear-gradient(135deg, #fff5e1 0%, #f5f8f5 55%, #eec6ff 100%)
        );
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.08);
    color: var(--blog-text);
}

.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    left: 0;
    height: 6px;
    background: var(
        --bg-gradient-signal,
        linear-gradient(90deg, #ff6900 0%, #ffb81c 58%, #ffd489 100%)
    );
}

.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways h2 {
    margin: 0 0 24px;
    color: var(--blog-text);
    text-wrap: balance;
}

/* Keep the standard rich-text list icon and spacing; only correct its color
   for this light surface. This also overrides the old component's light icon. */
.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways li::before {
    color: var(--font-bullet-dark-color) !important;
}

.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways a {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00) !important;
    text-decoration-color: currentColor !important;
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
}

.blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways a:hover {
    color: var(--brand-vantage-800, #8a1908) !important;
}

/* Responsive -------------------------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 991px) {
    .blog-detail {
        --blog-radius-lg: 24px;
        --blog-radius-md: 20px;
    }

    .blog-detail .hero--article .heading-1 {
        max-width: none;
    }

    .blog-detail .hero__sidebar {
        margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .blog-detail .hero__promo {
        margin-top: 24px;
    }
}

/* At the tablet breakpoint the legacy layout can leave .hero__image wider
   than its image, exposing a large empty outlined wrapper. Paint the image
   itself in this range instead. */
@media (min-width: 600px) and (max-width: 991px) {
    .blog-detail .hero__image {
        overflow: visible;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    .blog-detail .hero__image img {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.1);
        border-radius: 24px;
        box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.1);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 599px) {
    .blog-detail .hero__image {
        border-radius: 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(37, 40, 42, 0.1);
    }

    .blog-detail .hero__promo,
    .blog-detail .blog-key-takeaways {
        border-radius: 18px;
    }
}

@supports not (color: color-mix(in srgb, black, white)) {
    .blog-detail .hero--article a:not(.button) {
        text-decoration-color: var(--brand-vantage-700, #b72b00);
    }
}

    <script>
        var referrerOverride = function(referrer) {
   
    console.log('optimizely-referrer-override');
  };


  var sendCampaignData = function(campaignId, integrationString) {
 
    _sz.push(["event", "Optimizely Experiment Impression", integrationString.experiment, integrationString.variation]);
  };


  var initNewOptimizelyIntegration = function(referrerOverride, sendCampaignData) {
  
    var referrerOverwritten = false;
    var newActiveCampaign = function(id) {
      var state = window['optimizely'].get && window['optimizely'].get('state');
      var referrer = state.getRedirectInfo() && state.getRedirectInfo().referrer;
      if (!referrerOverwritten && referrer) {
        referrerOverride(referrer);
        referrerOverwritten = true;
      }
      var campaignId = id;
      var integrationString = state.getDecisionObject({'campaignId':campaignId});
      sendCampaignData(campaignId, integrationString);
  };

  var registerFutureActiveCampaigns = function() {
    window.optimizely = window.optimizely || [];
    try{
      window.optimizely.push({
        type: 'addListener',
        filter: {
          type: 'lifecycle',
          name: 'campaignDecided'
        },
        handler: function(event) {
          var id = event.data.campaign.id;
          newActiveCampaign(id);
        }
    });
    }catch(error){
      console.log('Something went wrong, this error can occur if there is a client side SDK. Which overwrites the optimizely object.');
    }
  };


  var registerCurrentlyActiveCampaigns = function(){
    var state = window['optimizely'] && window['optimizely'].get && window['optimizely'].get('state');
    if (state) {
      var activeCampaigns = state.getCampaignStates({
        isActive: true
      });
      for (var id in activeCampaigns) {
        newActiveCampaign(id);
      }
    }
  };

  registerCurrentlyActiveCampaigns();
  registerFutureActiveCampaigns();
};

  var initOptimizelyIntegration = function(referrerOverride, sendCampaignData) {
    initNewOptimizelyIntegration(referrerOverride, sendCampaignData);
 };

  initOptimizelyIntegration(referrerOverride, sendCampaignData);
    </script>
